Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class MulticastClientEventAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.MulticastClientEventAdapter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    MulticastClientEventHandler
    public class MulticastClientEventAdapter
extends Object
implements MulticastClientEventHandler
    Convenience adapter for handling MulticastClient events.

    Provides empty implementations of all methods defined by MulticastClientEventHandler. Applications may extend this class and override only the event callbacks they need.

    Using this adapter is optional and is not required for normal multicast client operation.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    MulticastClient, MulticastClientEventHandler
